mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the dragon was most worthwhile: its existing mounting holes and spare cam carried an earlier construction into the fair.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two brackets felt repetitive and straightforward, though both had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: I expected the accessory supply to connect to the attractions, but motors will still need actual shaft connections.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the single-option sequence left little room for decisions.

continue.text: I would continue to see the attractions operate on the whale, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this chapter offered.
